scope: Claude-style chat UI for the report-generation model: upload a chest X-ray, streamed stage timeline (preprocess, encode, retrieve, generate, label, score), similar training X-rays + matching reports (13D image and text encoders) with images, CheXbert labels, sessions stored/replayed/exported. NO MERGE into h100_scaling or main without an explicit user instruction.

rules.R1: DUA by construction: app/redact.py shapes every event before it is stored and sent, and every export; public payloads never carry image_url, study_id, subject_id, gallery_row, group, MIMIC report text, reference, test_row, identical_to, true_report_rank.
rules.R2: Protocol fidelity on the same device: engine == evaluate_report_generation.py byte for byte on the same node/device (hard); GPU engine-uncached == published dump (hard); CPU-vs-GPU drift measured and shown on every card, never claimed zero.
rules.R3: Thesis code untouched except on_step=None on beam_search_cached and beam_search_decode, each with parity tests.
rules.R4: Predict first: every cluster job's prediction recorded here and in the plan before submission; wrong predictions recorded beside the number.
rules.R5: Evidence or no tick: test name, job id + log path, or metric.
rules.R6: No unauthenticated exposure: the server refuses a non-loopback bind without a token; public mode also needs --mode public, a token file and the rate limit; tunnels stopped after demos.
rules.R7: No MIMIC text in an agent's context: never cat/tail/pull dumps or raw logs; cluster scripts print summary lines only; agents read logs only via scripts/chat_remote.sh summary (fixed pattern list, 8-digit ids masked).
rules.R8: Additive only: no deletion and no major change to existing files, data, checkpoints, the cluster checkout or shared venvs without the user's go-ahead; new files/dirs, symlinks inside CLUSTER_REPO and scancel of own jobs are allowed.
